newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Share index and volume down at Mauritius bourse.
newsitem.headline: Share index and volume down at Mauritius bourse.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius market index lost 2.33 points to 309.21 on Monday, reflecting a general downward trend in listed shares, brokers said.
Volume was down to 162,109 shares traded for 4.26 million rupees from 7.61 million rupees on 527,642 shares last Friday.

Brokers said market sentiment did not improve since last week when the index, semdex, started an accelerated downward slide after the Economist Intelligence Unit published a subdued future economic outlook for Mauritius in a country report.

Rogers, the largest conglomerate in Mauritius with activities extending in almost every sector of the economy, lost 2.0 rupees to 81.50 on 12,500 shares. Another conglomerate, Ireland Blyth, eased 30 cents to 11.50 rupees on 9,105 shares.

"Rogers, on its own, is a good proxy for the entire Mauritian economy. If it continues to fall, this shows how the perception on the future of the local economy has been adversely hit, probably by the Unit report," one broker said.
